verdict.rationale: pnpm documents a JSON output mode for `pnpm audit` ("Output audit report in JSON format"), so an agent can parse audit results. The pack shows no JSON output for other core commands such as install, its dry-run report, or listing licenses. missing for 10: documented JSON output for other core commands (install/dry-run, list, licenses, outdated, why), a consistent machine-readable output convention across the CLI, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent parsing.
